subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

EJCK, GMDO, IPES, ?, MVGA
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (2), (3), (1) and (4) is added to the position value of first, second, third and fourth letter according to the English alphabetic series respectively.

So,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/886200730003c70180d08eae0b2e00fe30365a339e9d697b5eb244ff86d8a981.png] 

Hence, "**KSFW**" is the correct answer.
